verdict.rationale: Bulk user management is a fair axis for a user-management SaaS. Clerk's only documented bulk capability is its first-party open-source migration tool, which takes a JSON or CSV list of users and creates them all through the Backend API while respecting rate limits. That covers a single import scenario rather than general bulk operations. missing for 10: bulk update/delete/ban of users, bulk organization or invitation operations, bulk actions exposed via MCP or CLI for AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
